project.name: linkfinderai.com
project.facts:
LinkFinder AI turns a name, company, email or LinkedIn URL into a verified business email or phone number. Plans start at $49/month for 5,000 credits. A LinkedIn-profile-to-email lookup costs 10 credits.

The outbound service: we build the list, write the campaign, run the sending and handle replies. You pay per meeting held.

campaign.offer: Outbound run end to end, paid per meeting held.
campaign.customer_problem: Prospecting stops whenever the team is delivering training, so the pipeline arrives in waves.

prompts.instructions: Ask for a reply, not a call. Never mention a discount. Name the pay-per-meeting model once — it is the whole reason this offer is different — and do not explain it twice.
